names.note: Read out of «Sfântul Apostol Andrei, cel întâi chemat» in doxologia.ro's account of the Synaxis of the Twelve Apostles for 30 iunie.
Read out of saint.gr's list of the twelve on its page for the Synaxis of 30 Ιουνίου, «Ανδρέας», with no rank word attached.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 186, «Апостол Андрей Первозванный», with the rank word left off. The day line declines it, «Апостола Андрея Первозванного». Первозванный, the first-called, is the by-name this folder's display name already carries.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 30. новембар ст. ст., „Св. апостол Андреја Првозвани.“ — «Св.» is “saint” and not a rank and «апостол» is the `apostle` grade this folder already keeps, so both come off. «Првозвани», the First-Called, is KEPT: it is not a rank but the by-name the whole Church knows him by, it is already in this folder’s display name and in its Russian form «Андрей Первозванный», and the corpus keeps another folder whose display name is the bare «Andrew». Measured before it was written: neither this form nor the bare «Андреја» stands on any other folder, so either would have joined no fold, and the fuller one is written because BRIEF-SERBIAN §6 asks for the fullest the calendar gives.

feast.note: His life pages head «Дни памяти: 20 июня (Перенесение мощей) , 30 июня (12 ап.) , 30 ноября» — the translation of his relics, the synaxis of the Twelve, and his own day. One row per church is the schema, so his own day is the feast here and the other two are recorded in this note; the Romanian rows on this folder record the same split from the other side.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 ноября ст. ст. — «Апостола Андрея Первозванного (62).»

feast.note: doxologia.ro keeps 30 iunie as the Synaxis of the Twelve Apostles, a common commemoration of all of them, and names each apostle in turn. It also keeps him on 30 noiembrie, his own day, as the protector of Romania, with a full life and a proper troparion of his own. Both days are now recorded, each as its own Romanian attestation with its own source.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 30 iunie — «Soborul Sfinților 12 Apostoli», whose life names him: «Sfântul Apostol Andrei, cel întâi chemat»

feast.note: His own day in the Romanian calendar, where the line reads «Sfântul Apostol Andrei, cel Înti Chemat, Ocrotitorul României» and the calendar keeps him as the protector of Romania, with a full life, a proper troparion, a canon and an acathist. The Synaxis of the Twelve on 30 iunie is recorded separately.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 30 noiembrie — «†) Sfântul Apostol Andrei, cel Înti Chemat, Ocrotitorul României», the day's first entry

feast.note: saint.gr keeps 30 Ιουνίου as the Synaxis of the Twelve Apostles, a common commemoration of all of them, and its page names each apostle in turn, this one among them. His own Greek day has not been read in this wave, and saint.gr will have a page for it; the corpus keeps one feast to a church, so the synaxis day is what is recorded here and whether the proper day should replace it is a question left to the writer (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ης Ιουνίου — «Σύναξη των Αγίων Δώδεκα Αποστόλων», whose page names him among the twelve
Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 13.12.2025 (30. новембар ст. ст.) — „Св. апостол Андреја Првозвани.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry. `dates` UNTOUCHED: the book says «Пострада св. Андреја за свога Господа 62. године», a flat 62, where this folder holds «c. 62» — the Russian calendar’s 62 with the word about from one of its own two life pages. A flat year does not remove another book’s about, and the about is not this reader’s to strike. No `related` row added: the folder already relates to eleven, and every person the entry names who has a folder is among them — the Forerunner whose disciple he first was, his brother whom he brought to the Lord, and the first bishop he set over Byzantium. AN ODDITY IN THIS FOLDER THAT IS NOT MINE AND IS NOT TOUCHED, recorded for the author: it carries TWO romanian rows, one on 30 June and one on 30 November, where the schema is one row per church; `upgrade.py` asserts only on the church it is changing, so the serbian row went in cleanly beside them. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS: that he was the son of Jonas and the brother of Peter, from Bethsaida, a fisherman by trade; that he was first a disciple of the Baptist and left his first teacher when that teacher pointed at the Lord Jesus with the words «гле, јагње Божје!», citing John 1:36, and that HE THEN BROUGHT HIS OWN BROTHER TO THE LORD; the lot that fell to him after the descent of the Holy Spirit — Byzantium and Thrace, then the Danube lands, then Russia and about the Black Sea, and last Epirus, Greece and the Peloponnese; the first bishop he set in Byzantium; THE CROSS HE PLANTED ON A HEIGHT AT KIEV AND THE BRIGHT CHRISTIAN FUTURE HE FORETOLD FOR THE RUSSIAN PEOPLE; the bishops and priests he appointed through Thrace, Epirus, Greece and the Peloponnese; the wonders at Patras and the brother and the wife of the imperial deputy Aegeates whom he won, which is what enraged Aegeates; the torture and the crucifixion; the useful teaching he kept giving from the cross to the Christians gathered round it, and HIS OWN REFUSAL to let the people take him down; and the unusual light that shone all over him as he prayed at the last, WHICH LASTED HALF AN HOUR, and his giving up his soul when it vanished. The relics to Constantinople, the head later to Rome and one hand to Moscow. Aegeates is not a saint of this corpus and the brother and wife he won are not named.

hymns.text: Cei ce sunteţi între apostoli mai întâi pe scaun şezători şi lumii învăţători, Stăpânului tuturor rugaţi-vă să dăruiască pace lumii şi sufletelor noastre mare milă.

source.text: Doxologia — Tropar la Soborul Sfinților 12 Apostoli; the troparion is printed for the twelve together.

english.text: O ye who are first enthroned among the Apostles and teachers of the world, pray to the Master of all that He grant peace to the world and to our souls great mercy.

hymns.text: Ὡς δωδεκάπυρσος, λυχνία ἔλαμψαν, οἱ Δωδεκάριθμοι, Χριστοῦ Ἀπόστολοι, Πέτρος καὶ Παῦλος σὺν Λουκᾶ, Ἀνδρέας καὶ Ἰωάννης, Βαρθολομαῖος Φίλιππος, σὺν Ματθαίω καὶ Σίμωνι, Μᾶρκος καὶ Ἰάκωβος, καὶ Θωμὰς ὁ μακάριος, καὶ ηὔγασαν τοὺς πίστει βοώντας χαίρετε Λόγου οἱ αὐτόπται.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Τὴν ὡραιότητα — the first of the three the page prints, which names him among the twelve, on the page of «Σύναξη των Αγίων Δώδεκα Αποστόλων»

english.text: As a lamp-stand of twelve flames the Apostles of Christ, twelve in number, shone out — Peter and Paul with Luke, Andrew and John, Bartholomew, Philip, with Matthew and Simon, Mark and James, and the blessed Thomas — and they gave light to those who cry out in faith: Rejoice, you who beheld the Word with your own eyes.

hymns.text: Οἱ τῶν Ἀποστόλων πρωτόθρονοι, καὶ τῆς Οἰκουμένης διδάσκαλοι, τῷ Δεσπότῃ τῶν ὅλων πρεσβεύσατε, εἰρήνην τῆ οἰκουμένῃ δωρήσασθαι, καὶ ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἡμῶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, on the page of «Σύναξη των Αγίων Δώδεκα Αποστόλων»

english.text: First-enthroned of the Apostles and teachers of the whole world, intercede with the Master of all things that He grant peace to the world and great mercy to our souls.

hymns.text: Ἀπόστολοι Ἅγιοι, πρεσβεύσατε τῷ ἐλεήμονι Θεῷ , ἵνα πταισμάτων ἄφεσιν, παράσχῃ ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ´ — the common of the apostles, naming nobody, on the page of «Σύναξη των Αγίων Δώδεκα Αποστόλων»

english.text: Holy Apostles, intercede with the merciful God, that He grant to our souls the forgiveness of our offences.

hymns.text: Τοὺς ἀσφαλεῖς καὶ θεοφθόγγους κήρυκας, τὴν κορυφὴν τῶν Μαθητῶν σου Κύριε, προσελάβου εἰς ἀπόλαυσιν, τῶν ἀγαθῶν σου καὶ ἀνάπαυσιν, τοὺς πόνους γὰρ ἐκείνων καὶ τὸν θάνατον, ἐδέξω ὑπὲρ πᾶσαν ὁλοκάρπωσιν, ὁ μόνος γινώσκων τὰ ἐγκάρδια.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Τοὺς ἀσφαλεῖς, on the page of «Σύναξη των Αγίων Δώδεκα Αποστόλων»

english.text: The sure and God-inspired heralds, the chief of Thy disciples, Thou hast taken to Thyself, O Lord, into the enjoyment of Thy good things and into rest; for Thou didst accept their labours and their death above every whole burnt offering, O Thou who alone knowest the secrets of the heart.

hymns.text: Яко апостолов первозванный/ и верховнаго сущий брат,/ Владыце всех, Андрее, молися,/ мир вселенней даровати// и душам нашим велию милость.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 ноября ст. ст. — «Тропарь апостола Андрея Первозванного (глас 4)»

english.text: As the first-called of the apostles and the brother of their chief, Andrew, pray to the Master of all to grant peace to the world and great mercy to our souls.

hymns.text: Мужества тезоименитаго богоглагольника/ и Церкве возследователя верховнаго,/ Петрова сродника восхвалим,/ зане якоже древле сему/ и ныне нам воззва:// приидите, обретохом Желаемаго.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 ноября ст. ст. — «Кондак апостола Андрея Первозванного (глас 2)»

english.text: Let us praise the speaker of God whose very name is courage, the chief follower of the Church, the kinsman of the chief apostle; for as he called out to him of old, so now he calls out to us: come, we have found the one we longed for.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes its line with the year, «Апостола Андрея Первозванного (62).», and both of its life pages repeat it, one of them with the word about: «Мученическая кончина апостола Андрея Первозванного последовала около 62 года после Рождества Христова», and the other «(+ 62)». Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gave this folder a year at all, so this is its first, and the display keeps the «около».
